subject: Expression of interest, junior Civil Designer, Townsville, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I lodged an expression of interest for a junior Civil Designer position in your Townsville team through the Spiire job board on [date Marc applied]. Your careers page invites a CV and motivation letter at this address, so I've attached both.

In short: an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design finished in February 2026 with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, a civil engineering degree (Philippines, 2019), and site experience on subdivision finishing works. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, hold full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, and I'm open to discussing relocation to Townsville.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. Happy to talk whenever suits the Townsville team.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
